details.name: Ardelia
details.quote: Greetings, Endministrator. The name's Ardelia and I'm a geologist from Rhodes Island. My current focus is the correlations between geological disasters and the Ætherside. I've heard about you for quite a while, Endmin, and I have so many questions for you. Oh, there's something else... Can I address you as my Professor?
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Natural Lore: Geological Surveyor Drop a plumb bob that points straight to the heart of this land.
details.exp2d: Adventure: Mountain Hiker Though aching and dazed, she labors hard to register the summit of the rocky outcrop.
details.hb1d: Lifestyle: Pastry Chef She's mixing some butter and chocolate to make an extra-large lava cake. "Patience, people! Everyone's getting a slice."
details.hb2d: Nature: Ecological Affinity The splattering of rain upon the land is the language by which the world renews itself. Everything gets a new look when tomorrow dawns.
details.matskill: Dreams of the Starry Beach, Chivalric Virtues, Opus: Etch Figure
